requirement: Passive Solar Orientation: Long axis of residential and public buildings should be oriented East-West to maximize South-facing solar exposure and radiation absorption.
source_document: Ladakh Standardized Development and Building Regulations 2023 / SP 73:2023
notes: Crucial high-altitude passive solar design principle for winter heating in Leh.

requirement: Double Glazing Mandate: All hotels guest houses commercial and government residential buildings must install double-glazed window units with uPVC or wooden thermal break frames.
source_document: Ladakh Draft Unified Building Bye-Laws / Regulations 2023
notes: Reduces fenestration heat loss by up to 50% compared to single glazing.

requirement: Local Eco-Friendly Building Materials: Minimum 50% of building walling materials should incorporate local eco-friendly options such as Compressed Stabilized Earth Blocks (CSEB) rammed earth adobe or local stone.
source_document: Ladakh Standardized Development and Building Regulations 2023
notes: Leverages regional thermal mass while preserving traditional Trans-Himalayan heritage.

requirement: South Wall Glazing & Rabsal: South elevation should feature enhanced glazing ratio or passive solar rabsal (sun-room) / Trombe wall heat collector to capture daytime solar gain.
source_document: Ladakh Standardized Development and Building Regulations 2023
notes: Trombe wall masonry thickness recommended at 200-350mm with dark absorptive coating.

requirement: North Wall Infiltration Protection: North-facing exterior wall openings must be minimized or protected with secondary non-conditioned utility buffer zones (storage corridors stairwells).
notes: Protects building envelope from prevailing cold winter northern wind infiltration.

requirement: Roof Thermal Insulation Mandate: Roof assemblies must incorporate continuous thermal insulation (minimum R >= 2.5 m²K/W) using local thatch/straw layering or mineral wool/EPS/XPS rigid insulation.
source_document: Ladakh Standardized Development and Building Regulations 2023
notes: Roof accounts for up to 35% of total building winter heat loss if uninsulated.

requirement: Ground & Perimeter Slab Insulation: Ground floor slabs must incorporate perimeter edge insulation (e.g. 50mm XPS) or sub-slab insulation to break frost conduction ground pathways.
notes: Prevents severe sub-zero ground frost conduction into living space floor slab.

requirement: Air Infiltration Weather-Sealing: Envelope joints window perimeters and door frames must be weather-stripped to maintain controlled air change rate (ACH <= 0.5 h-1).
source_document: National Building Code of India 2016 Part 8 / Ladakh Regs
notes: Restricts winter cold air infiltration drafts in high-wind high-altitude zones.

requirement: Seismic & Snow Load Construction: Structural timber lacing or reinforced concrete ring beams must be integrated into masonry walls to resist Trans-Himalayan seismic activity (Zone IV/V) and heavy snow loads.
source_document: Ladakh Standardized Development and Building Regulations 2023
notes: Ensures structural safety under severe earthquake and snow load events.

requirement: Geothermal & Active Solar FAR Incentives: Additional Floor Area Ratio (FAR) incentives are provided for buildings incorporating verified geothermal heat pumps or active solar water/air heating systems.
notes: Encourages adoption of clean renewable heating technologies in Ladakh.
